fast: Thu 5 Nov is a sunnah fast.
blessing: Your rizq. Say Alhamdulillah at your first meal and give a small sadaqah.

verse.text: ...Allah alone is sufficient for us and He is the best Protector.

hadith.text: If you were to rely upon Allah with the required reliance, He would provide for you as a bird is provided for: it goes out in the morning empty and returns full.

lesson.title: Names of Allah part 2: Al-Wakil
lesson.text: Tawakkul comes from the same root. "Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal Wakil" was said by Ibrahim in the fire and by the Prophet ﷺ. Do your part properly, then leave the result to Allah.

quote.text: If your success intimidates or upsets others, then they have a problem... mind their own journeys.

videos.title: Omar Suleiman: Hasbunallahu wa Ni'mal Wakeel
